title: Learning Discrete Riemannian Metrics for Physical Fields with Cochain-Frame Equivarianc
abstract: arXiv:2608.14556v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Physical fields on meshes require a separation between topology and geometry: conservation laws are topological and should be exact, while geometry, material response, and anisotropic coupling must be learned from data. Existing neural surrogates often mix these roles inside unconstrained message passing. We introduce Riemannian Hodge Message Passing (RHMP), which turns this separation into an architectural principle. RHMP fixes the cellular coboundaries ($d_k$) determined by oriented incidence and learns symmetric positive-definite cochain metrics ($H_k$) for geometry-dependent propagation. Treating $H_k$ as the learned metric motivates cochain-frame equivariance: physical propagation should be invariant to orthogonal changes of the hidden cochain feature basis. RHMP implements this principle with metric-weighted Hodge blocks ($d_k^\top H_{k+1}d_k$), yielding exact cochain-complex identities ($d_{k+1}d_k=0$), nonnegative Hodge energies,

translated_title: 学习物理场离散黎曼度量与余链框架等变性
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.14556v1 公告类型：新 摘要：网格上的物理场需要将拓扑与几何分离：守恒定律是拓扑的，应当精确成立，而几何、材料响应和各向异性耦合必须从数据中学习。现有的神经替代模型常常在无约束的消息传递中混淆这些角色。我们引入了黎曼霍奇消息传递（RHMP），将这种分离转化为架构原则。RHMP固定由定向关联决定的细胞余边界（$d_k$），并学习对称正定余链度量（$H_k$）以进行几何依赖的传播。将$H_k$视为学习度量，激发了余链框架等变性：物理传播应对隐藏余链特征基的正交变化保持不变。RHMP通过度量加权霍奇块（$d_k^\top H_{k+1}d_k$）实现这一原则，从而确保精确的余链复形恒等式（$d_{k+1}d_k=0$）和非负霍奇能量。
tldr: RHMP通过将拓扑与几何分离并学习余链度量，实现了物理场的精确守恒与几何依赖传播的统一。
en_tdlr: RHMP unifies exact conservation and geometry-dependent propagation for physical fields by separating topology from geometry and learning cochain metrics.
